refnamediv.refpurpose: Retrieve the name of the local or remote sockets

refentry.refsect1:
&reftitle.parameters;
socket
The socket to get the name of. Other streams, such as plain files or php://memory, have no name.
remote
If set to &true; the remote socket name will be returned, if set to &false; the local socket name will be returned.

&reftitle.returnvalues;
The name of the socket, as ip:port, [ipv6]:port (an IPv4 peer of a dual-stack listener is shown as [::ffff:127.0.0.1]:port) or, for a Unix domain socket, the path of its file. &false; is returned, without any warning, if the socket has no name to report: an unnamed Unix domain socket (the local name of a client, or a socket from stream_socket_pair), an abstract-namespace Unix domain socket, the remote name of a listening or unconnected socket, or a stream that is not a socket.
